name: audio_pitch_harmonics
expr: f220 = pitch(x220, fs); f100 = pitch(x100, fs); h220 = harmonicRatio(x220, fs); pn220 = numel(f220); hn220 = numel(h220); f220_first = f220(1); f220_mean = mean(f220); f100_mean = mean(f100); h220_mean = mean(h220); fcep220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'CEP'); cep_first = fcep220(1); cep_2 = fcep220(2); cep_4 = fcep220(4); cep_mean = mean(fcep220); fpef220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'PEF'); pef_first = fpef220(1); pef_mean = mean(fpef220); xmix = sin(2*pi*220*t) + 0.5*sin(2*pi*100*t); fpef_range = pitch(xmix, fs, 'Method', 'PEF', 'Range', [80 250]); pef_r_first = fpef_range(1); flhs220 = pitch(x220, fs, 'Method', 'LHS'); lhs_first = flhs220(1); lhs_2 = flhs220(2); lhs_mean = mean(flhs220);
comment: MATLAB Audio Toolbox cycles E + F + K + K-2 + K-3: pitch + harmonicRatio. pitch via NCF (default), CEP (cycle K — bit-equal), PEF (cycle K-2 — bit-equal), LHS (cycle K-3 — bit-equal Hermes 1988 Subharmonic Summation). Cycle F: harmonicRatio gained MATLAB parity. Cycle K-3 LHS: edge=[ceil(minF), floor(maxF)]; fftLength=round(fs); maxBin=(edge(end)+1)*5; S=log(|fft|); domain[k]=Σ_{m=1..5} S[k*m]; max in domain[edge(0)..edge(end)]; f0=peak idx (Hz, since NFFT=fs → 1Hz/bin). For pure sines LHS picks low subharmonic at search edge (~50 Hz for 220 Hz input — correct Hermes behavior, documented). 16/16 fingerprints OK. KNOWN GAP: 'SRH' still deferred (uses LPC residual + Blackman framing — separate algorithm); pitchnn deferred (DNN runtime). Tolerance 5% for parity (algorithmic equivalence; CEP/PEF/LHS are bit-equal).
